description: openHop MeshCore repeater for CardputerZero + Cap LoRa-1262

store.summary: Turn your CardputerZero + Cap LoRa-1262 into a MeshCore repeater
store.description: Runs the openHop Repeater daemon on the SX1262 radio in the Cap LoRa-1262. The on-device app starts and stops the repeater, picks your radio region, toggles start-at-boot and shows the address of the full web dashboard. The repeater is off until you start it, and runs as an unprivileged user. Requires the Cap LoRa-1262 with its antenna attached. While the repeater runs, the M5 LoRa and GPS apps cannot use the radio.
